remaining.title: Fix release identity in production
remaining.detail: /api/health/live returns commitSha null and commitRef null on deployment queueproof-n1zo1ybn5. /api/lab therefore reports currentRelease.commitSha null and degrades live and pdf to awaiting_current_release_measurement, emptying the judge-facing benchmark surface. Route logic is unit-proven by tests/health-release.test.ts, so the fix is deployment configuration: set QUEUEPROOF_RELEASE_SHA and QUEUEPROOF_RELEASE_REF on the Vercel production environment, or deploy so VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA is present.

remaining.title: Fix grounded synthesis defect D1
remaining.detail: Write the failing test first in tests/synthesis.test.ts encoding the Atlas Copco job-listing case, then fix lib/server/synthesis.ts: entity disambiguation (Atlas Copco is not Atlas Launch), claim-level relevance gating, cross-claim dedup, and answer shape so the blocker leads. Also cover the companion symptom: 'What did we ship most recently and what proves it?' currently abstains with 0 citations.

remaining.title: Add dist/** to eslint globalIgnores
remaining.detail: eslint.config.mjs globalIgnores lists only .next/**, out/**, build/**, next-env.d.ts. Bare `eslint .` reports 41 errors, all inside generated dist/. Add a narrow dist/** entry; do not weaken source rules.

confirmedDefects.title: Grounded synthesis glues unrelated evidence onto the answer

confirmedDefects.observed: HTTP 200, 6.15s, 4 citations. The answer leads and ends with an Atlas Copco job-listing fragment, claims [2] and [3] are near-duplicates, and the question is never answered.
confirmedDefects.companionSymptom: 'What did we ship most recently and what proves it?' returns an abstention with 0 citations (21.1s), so neither flagship demo question currently produces a usable answer.
